purpose: Test whether supported synthesis controls improve appropriate expression without reducing clarity or voice stability.

contract.estimateBasis: 188 words at an assumed 130 words per minute plus seven 0.28-second turn gaps gives approximately 89 seconds; measure actual output.
contract.comparisonUnit: One complete snippet; never compare individual words in isolation.

beforeRender: Verify the existing approval and usage record for each reference; an audio filename alone is not evidence.
Resolve reference paths, hash their bytes and freeze speaker mapping in the run manifest.
Check the frozen mapping against approved host identity; the September audition had opposite filename mappings.
Verify local model snapshot identity and package version; fail instead of downloading a missing model.

seedPlan.rule: seedBase + one-based utterance order across the six snippets; use identical seeds in paired arms

candidates.condition: Only after round 1 shows useful expression but a measured fast-delivery defect; compare with cb-expression.
Use in a separate bounded run, or when GPU production is unavailable; different voice identity prevents a causal expression comparison.

snippets.performanceIntent: Host A admits a small mistake with embarrassment; host B responds with recognition and gentle relief, without sounding like a teacher praising a pupil.

utterances.speaker: host_a
utterances.text: I called my new manager Mum. In front of the whole team. I wanted to disappear.

utterances.speaker: host_b
utterances.text: Oh, no. What did she say? Please tell me she laughed with you.

snippets.performanceIntent: A short, vulnerable admission receives calm, specific support. Keep warmth intimate and restrained; no whispering or exaggerated sadness.

utterances.speaker: host_a
utterances.text: Everyone else seems to know what they are doing. I keep checking the same email.

utterances.speaker: host_b
utterances.text: You have answered the question. Read it once, then send it. I can sit here with you.

snippets.performanceIntent: Two reasonable people disagree. Host B pushes back with mild conviction, then offers a practical alternative; no argument or sarcastic contempt.

utterances.speaker: host_a
utterances.text: If I practise every morning, I will never miss a day. That is the plan.

utterances.speaker: host_b
utterances.text: Never? I would plan for a messy morning too. Five minutes still counts when life gets in the way.

snippets.performanceIntent: The joke comes from timing and understatement. Host A is sincerely pleased, host B gently punctures the claim, and host A concedes. Do not insert laughter tokens.

utterances.speaker: host_a
utterances.text: I bought a notebook to organise all my unfinished projects.

utterances.speaker: host_b
utterances.text: And have you written anything in it yet?

utterances.speaker: host_a
utterances.text: No. Choosing the right pen has become another project.

snippets.performanceIntent: A brief misunderstanding is repaired immediately. Preserve the question's uncertainty and the final speaker's self-correction without rushing or adding filler.

utterances.speaker: host_a
utterances.text: Could you check the figures before lunch? I only need the total, not the whole report.

utterances.speaker: host_a
utterances.text: Tomorrow. Sorry, I should have said that first. Today would be a little ambitious.

snippets.performanceIntent: One narrator moves from patient observation to quiet expectation. Keep the long sentence coherent, articulate Eleanor and Frederick, and land the final contrast without melodrama.

utterances.speaker: host_b
utterances.text: Eleanor checked the letter again: Thursday, the twenty-third of September. Frederick would arrive before sunset, if the sea stayed calm. She placed two cups on the table, then quietly put one away.

assembly.gapScope: Between utterances inside a snippet only; snippets remain separate review files.
assembly.round1ReviewProcessing: Identical peak-safe gain and loudness matching only; no denoise, compressor, music, effects or video.
assembly.ifTargetConflictsWithPeak: Use the quieter common level for both arms and record it; do not compress one arm differently.
assembly.laterMasteringComparison: After synthesis selection, compare the same raw WAVs through minimal processing and the existing full chain, with matched loudness.

budget.resourceRule: Honor the existing heavy-resource lease and stricter runtime gates; unknown process visibility stops the trial. Do not increase batch size to meet the clock.
budget.stopRule: Stop at the first budget limit, repeated process crash, missing model/reference, or unavailable resource. Preserve partial traces and mark incomplete; do not run the remaining candidates automatically.

blindReview.scheme: Randomise A/B order independently per snippet and keep the code map separate until scoring is saved.
blindReview.listenerRecruitment: Owner-arranged volunteers; no paid recruiting or automatic outreach.
blindReview.promotionRule: Candidate must be preferred on at least four of six snippets, have median naturalness/appropriate_emotion/intelligibility/voice_stability at least 4, and show no intelligibility or voice-stability regression. This is a provisional local selection rule, not statistical proof of audience preference.
hardFailures: Audible unrequested words or missing meaning
Mispronounced target names not resolved in review
blindReview.nextGate: Passing this short audition permits one 8-12 minute fatigue test, not public release or a full production week.

evidence.missingMeasurementRule: Use null with a reason; never infer peak memory or listening approval from a successful render.
decisionMetrics: Wall minutes per accepted audio minute
